ai_summary: DSP Trustee Private Limited, representing various funds, has significantly reduced its stake in Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited through an open market sale, bringing their total holding from 3.04% down to 2.45%. This disclosure was triggered because their cumulative shareholding has decreased by more than 2% since their last substantial reporting (previously above 5%). This material reduction by a major institutional investor could signal a shift in investment strategy or a less favorable outlook on the company's future prospects.
